title: Seasonal Plant Reload Months for Orders Released From Hold
content:
By the month of the release date, seasonal reloading adds business days to the ship date set when a customer hold on Factory Production Orders is released:

| Month of the release date | Business days added |
|---|---|
| June, July or August | 3 |
| April, May, September or October | 1 |
| January, February, March, November or December | none |

The days added are counted in business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) starting the day after the ship date first set at release, and the date reached is the requoted ship date.

## Points of reading

- Only the calendar month of the release date matters — not the month the hold began and not the month of the ship date.
- Month edges: a release on 31 May adds 1 business day; a release on 1 June adds 3. A release on 31 August adds 3; a release on 1 September adds 1. A release on 31 October adds 1; a release on 1 November adds none.

## Hypothetical example (no federal holiday in the period)

An order released on a Tuesday in July has its ship date first set on a Thursday. Three business days counted from the Friday — Friday, Monday, Tuesday — make the requoted ship date the Tuesday.
